name: praxis
description: Praxis: the disciplined practice of engineering, applied automatically in Claude Code. A per-prompt router turns any request, typed or commanded, into a full pipeline: restructure into a spec, investigate, plan, implement to production standard with professional code-craft and the right best-practices, then run an adversarial vertical and horizontal audit (including completeness and no-regression), update the project's living knowledge (/docs, CHANGELOG, ADRs), and deliver the result as a reviewable pull request. Includes a full front-end pipeline (business research, story-first wireframes, design system, build, optimize) with a design-craft reference, triggered by the surface a change touches rather than by how it was phrased. Deterministic hooks block unfinished or deferred work, require verified test evidence, refuse em dashes and AI co-author credits, and report documentation that contradicts the repo's live configuration. Bootstraps any repo, keeps CLAUDE.md and docs regression-free, and can run fully autonomous (auto-pilot).
